title: Advisory Engagement Runbook: Triage, SLA, Pricing & Handoff
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Background: We receive increasing non-bug customer requests asking for optimization advice (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies). Current triage is ad-hoc across support, SE, and engineering which causes variable SLAs, missed billing opportunities, and inconsistent recommendations.

Goal: Produce a repeatable runbook that defines an intake schema, a lightweight scoring/triage rubric, mapped SLA response tiers (free vs paid), pricing/engagement templates, and a clear handoff path to SE/ENG/Dedicated teams. The runbook should minimize engineering context-switch, create predictable timelines for customers, and allow reporting on advisory throughput and outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: A documented intake form (fields + validation) used by Support/SDR/SE
Triage rubric with example scores and thresholds for routing to: self-service guidance, SE consult, paid advisory, or engineering deep-dive
SLA table that maps triage outcomes to response time and deliverables (e.g., 3 business days for SE consult)
Pricing/engagement templates for paid advisory (time & materials + retainer options) and clear billing trigger points
Handoff checklist linking tickets/alerts to ENG owner with required artifacts (repro, perf traces, token-cost profile, workload samples)
Dashboards tracking inbound advisory volume, median time-to-first-response, ratio of free->paid conversions, and satisfaction score
proposal: Create a single-page runbook and a canonical intake form surfaced in Support tooling + SE playbook. Triage will produce a numeric score (0-10) derived from four axes: potential_cost_savings, customer_size_sla_risk, technical_complexity, and regression_risk. Routing rules: score <= 2 => self-serve guide; 3-5 => SE consult (free, 1 reply); 6-7 => paid advisory engagement (short engagement with templated scope); >=8 => engineering investigation (ENG ticket + priority review). Formalize estimated turnaround per bucket and publish to customer-facing KB where applicable.
intake_schema: Observed problem or ask (free text; 2500 chars)
Desired outcome (cost reduction / latency improvement / reliability / accuracy)
Workload profile: avg tokens per request, p95 latency target, qps, seq length distribution
Current model & config: model name, quantization, batch_size, caching enabled (yes/no), routing policy
Attachments: logs, perf traces (flamegraph), sample requests (optional)
sla_table: Self-serve guidance: acknowledgment within 48 business hours; link to KB; no direct SE time
SE consult (score 3-5): first substantive reply within 3 business days; up to 1 hour of SE time; follow-up recommended via paid advisory
Paid advisory (score 6-7): kickoff within 5 business days; scoped 4-12 hours of engagement; deliverable = optimization plan + config diff + validation checklist

Engineering investigation (score >=8): triage ticket created in ENG backlog within 2 business days; expected initial findings within 7 business days; may convert to prioritized engineering work depending on impact
pricing_tiers: Free: SE consults and self-serve guidance are covered for customers on business plan as goodwill (limits apply)
Ad-hoc paid advisory: hourly T&M rate (default 200 USD/hr) with 4-12 hour scoped engagements; cap and estimate required prior to start
Retainer: monthly advisory block (e.g., 40 hours/month) with 10% discount on T&M; includes quarterly optimization review
Enterprise SLA add-on: fast-track advisory response and tech review with guaranteed timelines (premium pricing; contractual)
handoff_steps: 1) Intake completed in Support tool with attachments and computed triage score
2) If routed to SE consult: assign to SE queue, tag customer tier, and set 3-business-day SLA
3) If routed to paid advisory: create a scoped engagement doc, send estimate, wait for PO/approval, then schedule kickoff
4) If escalated to ENG: open ENG-<new> ticket with reproducible steps, perf traces, cost profile, and business impact note; request architecture review
5) Post-engagement: close loop with customer via success note, update KB with generalized guidance, and create feedback ticket for product improvements if recurring
stakeholders: Solutions Engineering: SE consults, scoping, and customer communications
Product Management: owner of runbook and SLA thresholds
Engineering (Serving/runtime): investigatory support and engineering engagements
Sales/Account Management: approvals for paid engagements and contract changes
